notes: Region model for slice-10 sub-slicing. mutmut only_mutate is whole-file, so each region is realized by # pragma: no mutate fencing (NOT only_mutate). Per the spike (spikes/solution-subslicing.md, Proof 3), pragma fencing is only safe when both fence boundaries are same-block-level siblings; same_level_fence records this, and a mandatory PragmaVisitor dry-parse gate must pass before any live mutmut run. Budget numbers use the plan sizing FLOOR (0.78 mutants/LOC, 20% survive) until slice-8 calibration lands measured mpl/rate/srate. covering_test_selection on EVERY region is the whole-module covering set as a PLACEHOLDER; per-region narrowing needs --cov-context=test tooling not yet in covering-set-discover.sh. same_level_fence=true describes the outer fence's fenceability, not mutation-readiness (the dry-parse gate + calibration gate a live run).
source_safety: Single serial actor. Backup Solution.py, trap restore on EXIT INT TERM, clear mutmut mutants/ between regions, require `git -C projects/hipblaslt/tensilelite diff --quiet -- Tensile/SolutionStructs/Solution.py` before the next region and before any commit. Never leave fences in tracked source.
